scope.authority: Current production registration and source behavior on the next integration line. This inventory freezes observed behavior; it does not authorize R1-R11 implementation or claim artifact/live evidence.
scope.production_registration: desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs::run generate_handler plus setup, boot, run-event, and Drop hooks
exclusions: Unregistered commands in desktop/src-tauri/src/commands/skills.rs are not production surface.
Scratch probes are classified but are not durable runtime mutations.
Pure UI one-shot consumption, including pending_notice and boot_attention, is classified but excluded from runtime operation plans.

Migration backups, rolling config backups, and user-selected downgrade exports are frozen as ordered effects and failure outcomes where R0 requires them; they are not generalized into a repository-wide artifact ontology.
Browser/Finder open actions are classified as external side effects, not managed runtime mutations.
Artifact, installed app, live provider, live Science, SSH server, signing, notarization, and public release behavior are NOT-RUN.
scope.test_identity_semantics: characterization_tests lists required stable identities for R0 completion, not evidence that every identity already exists. The fail-closed inventory test resolves these identities before R0 can be declared complete; planned names remain an explicit incomplete state until their tests are implemented.

durable_records.format: 0600 newline-terminated Skill bridge token file at runtime/skill-install-bridge.key

This is the authoritative enable/disable generation marker; stale secret files can remain after a delete failure but are rejected while committed=false.
Login and refresh compensate partial publication by restoring the prior record; rollback failure is surfaced as RollbackFailed rather than claiming restoration.
Logout commits the disabled auth state before attempting both secret deletions, so a delete failure may retain a disabled stale record.

durable_records.format: Private Science encryption.key, encrypted OAuth token, and active-org.json credential bundle
durable_records.known_gap: The credential files and history marker are separate atomic publications; history restore can fail after some credential files changed and has no command-level rollback.

durable_records.format: Science config.toml ssh_hosts projection plus csswitch-ssh-bridge.v1.json ownership sidecar
durable_records.known_gap: Preparation uses a transitional sidecar around config publication; revoke fails closed on external drift and has no broader operation journal.
Science creates the candidate stub out of process; compensation deletes or restores only when exact captured identity/content still matches.
